sources.title: smhfacct/Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Limitations Acknowledgements MiniMax H3 Hybrid (fl2va base + ref2va reference pathway) This is a merged variant of MiniMax H3, a joint audio+video diffusion transformer (DiT). It combines the two officially released MiniMax H3 checkpoints — fl2vaand ref2va— into a single model that aims to keep the best qualities of each.
